research_question: Effect of numerical accuracy versus inputwise decision and margin-linked error acceptance on configurations, held-out decisions, and costs
architecture: 784-100-10 square; unmodified original Go TrainMLP and optimizer
splitting: SHA256 deterministic per-class rank from train, dev500/class then selection50/class then rest training; official test held out
preprocessing: uint8 / 255, no fitted normalization or output scaling

numerical_comparators.type: representative precision reference, not reproduction of named prior paper
numerical_comparators.reference: round development logits to IEEE binary16 and back to float64
numerical_comparators.rmse_threshold: sqrt(mean((dev_logits-float16(dev_logits))^2)) over all development rows and logits
numerical_comparators.max_abs_threshold: max(abs(dev_logits-float16(dev_logits))) over all development rows and logits
numerical_comparators.rationale: development-output-dependent numerical precision budget; no labels, margins, CKKS or test outputs determine thresholds; engineering reference, no application adequacy guarantee
numerical_comparators.selection: fastest numerically passing finite candidate by original selection timing, all repeated keys must meet the corresponding numerical condition; full finite-set post-hoc selection, not bounded online search
numerical_comparators.edge_cases: float16 overflow or zero threshold recorded; no outcome-based substitute tolerance

resource_preliminary.main_scope_decision: after legacy cost and development-only smoke, before selection/audit; evaluate full10000 if affordable
